أصطفق (form VIII)
# أَصْطَفِقُ (ʔaṣṭafiqu) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.fi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# أَصْطَفِقَ (ʔaṣṭafiqa) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.fi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# أَصْطَفِقْ (ʔaṣṭafiq) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.fiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
